Hero_Desc_Jade:
Dragon who treats knowledge as treasure. A jade dragon.
Her greed of knowledge is so great that it makes her unwilling to teach or disseminate information to others.
She doesn't have wings despite being a dragon... What could the story behind this be?
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_Jade: Don't Tease Me for Being Gullible
Album_Hate_Jade: Abuse of magic. Digging into personal secrets.
Album_Hobby_Jade: Falling asleep while reading a book, face down.
Album_Wish_Jade: Completing a collection of out-of-print books, one missing volume at a time.
Album_Jade1: A dragon collector who sequestered herself in a corner, Jade is only interested in dusty books and jadestones.
Album_Jade2: Seemingly the most knowledgeable on magic among dragons, Ashur, a sprite with an interest in magic, appears eager to study magic with Jade. But it seems Jade's goal is to collect items, rather than research them.
Album_Jade3: Jade stays in her roost and doesn't move much once she sits down. Daya, the dragon chief, began to worry whether she would even move if asked.
Album_Jade4: Unlike other dragons, who just display the gems they are obsessed with, Jade actually consumes the jadestones. To be clear, she only eats 'germanium jadestones'... Maybe she's been bamboozled?
Album_Jade5: Jade always feels a little left out among the dragons. She seems perfectly happy, quietly enjoying her own time, but it is a little concerning.
Album_Jade6: Isn't Jade a dragon from Elias? Jade herself says she feels as though she came from somewhere far away. It appears she thinks her hometown is somewhere far to the east.
Album_Jade7: I was curious about Jade's broken horn and finally asked about it. I worried it might be a sensitive topic, but... Jade casually said that she grinds her horn down occasionally and sell the powder. She calls it "Dragon. Herb. Powder." Apparently, it sells for a high price.
LoveHero_Jade:
Ahh... time for social life...
Is it that time?
The outside is dangerous...
LoveHeroCancel_Jade:
Haha, freedom!
I should go home and
catch up on my
backlog of comics!
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Hate1: After seeing this drink, Jade described it as 'the sweat from dirt.' Obviously, this never touched her lips.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Hate2: Jade politely gave it back, saying this was like 'the meat from the picture books' she used to read, and that eating it would shatter her fantasies.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Like1: After trying this amazing food, Jade got so excited that she began writing about it in her journal, which was filled with her observations and praise—at least until closing time.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Like10: After tasting it, Jade began praising the dish with every elaborate flourish she could muster. She seems to have gathered all the prettiest expressions from the books she has read.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Like2: Jade always eats this candy as a snack while reading books, and she enjoys it on most days too.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Like3: Jade liked it, saying it strangely makes her mind work better when eaten.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Like4: After initially being misinformed with the half-truth that this would make her a year older, she didn't want to eat this. But now, she eats it just fine.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Like5: She asked if it was acquired from Sist, as it tasted remarkably like her favorite cure-all potion.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Like6: After giving Jade this cake, she was forcibly enlightened with 15 facts about the Bûche de Noël.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Like7: Jade wondered why eating rice cake soup makes you age a year. I just stuffed her mouth to avoid having to give a long explanation.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Like8: Jade wondered if it was a black jade stone, but after one bite, she seemed ready to switch snacks.
Food_ChefNote_Jade_Like9: Jade picks one candy at a time while reading a book. She gradually started placing candies in weird spots, eventually sticking one to her glasses.

LoveLetter_Jade: Master, consider it an honor! A letter penned by me, Jade, will soon be treated as a treasured relic of Elias! ...Well, that's not exactly what I meant to say. I wanted to thank you. Watching you nag every day, I wondered why you do that... But then I read in a book once: nagging... it's just another form of caring. So please continue to take care of me. From Jade.
LoveCall_Jade:
Hello? Ah, Master! Did my sudden call surprise you?
Nothing happened... I simply obtained some new books and wanted you to come see them!
You have borrowed books from me from time to time, remember? Thinking of that made me call.
You know I rarely lend my books to anyone else, right?
So consider it an honor. I am giving you special treatment!

Hmm? Why are you the only one who receives special treatment?
Well... monopolizing books is enjoyable, but reading the same book as you and sharing what we learned is fun too.
Perhaps that is why I keep opening the vaults of my knowledge to you.

So, Master, you must keep reading with me and talking about books with me, all right?
I will hang up now, so hurry over and see the books!
Affinity_Jade_EP01_001:
Are there any more books I can collect?
I've collected just about every book there is, so it's hard to satisfy my desire for more.
Affinity_Jade_EP01_002: Greed is insatiable. You should learn when to let go.
Affinity_Jade_EP01_003:
What if I don't want to let go?
I live for the fun of collecting them. What do I do if I stop?
Affinity_Jade_EP01_004: Why not broaden your scope? Like comic books or films?
Affinity_Jade_EP01_005:
I'm not sure if those can be considered knowledge...
Hmm... maybe I'm being too restrictive in my thinking?
Affinity_Jade_EP01_006: Why don't you write a new book?
Affinity_Jade_EP01_007: Writing the books I want to collect...? Oh, I think I might develop a new area of interest!
Affinity_Jade_EP02_001: I heard that elves have a mineral that glows fluorescent green. I wonder if I can get my hands on it.
Affinity_Jade_EP02_002: I thought you were done collecting green gems?

Affinity_Jade_EP02_004: Fluorescent green mineral...? Do you mean it's radioact—
Affinity_Jade_EP02_005: What are you talking about? You know that radioactive materials don't really glow green, right?
Affinity_Jade_EP02_006: I'll see what I can do, but I can't make any promises.
Affinity_Jade_EP02_007: Yes, of course! I knew you could do it! Good thing I joined the Order!
Affinity_Jade_EP03_001: If I were to move somewhere else, where would you recommend I go?
Affinity_Jade_EP03_002: Is it hard to live among other dragons?
Affinity_Jade_EP03_003: It's not that it's hard to live there, it's just that we have... well... different tastes? Something like that.
Affinity_Jade_EP03_004: You'd probably get along well with elves who are researchers.
Affinity_Jade_EP03_005: Elves? You think so? Interesting! Okay, I'll keep that in mind.
Affinity_Jade_EP03_006: How about moving next door to a bakery owner with an academic degree?

That self-proclaimed professor of magic must've asked you to say that, huh?

Affinity_Jade_EP04_002: Don't we all speak the same language though?
Affinity_Jade_EP04_003:

It's like having "written dialects."
Affinity_Jade_EP04_004: I never thought about it because I could understand you all from the beginning, but what's the language here called?
Affinity_Jade_EP04_005:
Huh? You didn't know this whole time? It's called the "Ancient Tongue"!
It's "ancient" because it was taught to us by the First Human a very long time ago.
Affinity_Jade_EP04_006: You don't have to actually read the books, do you? Just collect them.
Affinity_Jade_EP04_007:

The knowledge the books contain is the real treasure!

Affinity_Jade_EP05_006: I have Erpin write them, who claims that Ner had asked her to do it.
Affinity_Jade_EP05_007: Ah, I see... Hmm. Okay, can't do anything about that, then.

Affinity_Jade_EP06_004: Because there's no need to? It's okay as long as you know what they mean.
Affinity_Jade_EP06_005: Hmm... Yeah, I guess there's nothing wrong if you understand each other.
Affinity_Jade_EP06_006: Do they have such a thing here?! What are they?
Affinity_Jade_EP06_007:
You didn't know? The proper noun for Sprite Kingdom is Erpien,
and for the Witch Kingdom, it's Belitein!
Affinity_Jade_EP07_001:
I'm not sure why,
but I don't think accumulating knowledge has anything to do with becoming smart.
Affinity_Jade_EP07_002: It's all about using the right knowledge in the right context.
Affinity_Jade_EP07_003:
Yes, you should be able to understand the situation and the context.
If you get even a little off-topic, you might start spouting nonsense.

Affinity_Jade_EP07_005: I-I am smart! I'm talking about someone else! Not me, at all!

Affinity_Jade_EP07_007: But what does "reading the room" actually mean? I wish there were a book on that!
Affinity_Jade_EP08_001: Even if I knew that tomorrow Elias would go to pieces...
Affinity_Jade_EP08_002: ...I would still plant my apple tree.
Affinity_Jade_EP08_003:
Yes, right! It's a great quote.

Affinity_Jade_EP08_004: ...You can sell your house and start over.
Affinity_Jade_EP08_005:

I guess it kinda makes sense like that.
Affinity_Jade_EP08_007: Nothing. It'll be so over for us.

Affinity_Jade_EP09_006: Why are you staring at my head like that?

Affinity_Jade_EP10_001: There's no room for more books in my cave. What should I do?

Affinity_Jade_EP10_004: How about using the books you don't read to create new bookshelves?

Affinity_Jade_EP10_007:
Urgh, I hate physical labor.
